platform_2_perplexity.finding: Perplexity answered both informational prompts from national brands and state agencies rather than local operators. That is the opposite of Google AI Overviews, which cited a local operator (Pine State) for the same mice prompt. The route into Perplexity-style answers is being the best-sourced local explainer — a page that names Maine CDC, the Maine Forest Service and the Board of Pesticides Control in its visible sentences, which is how the new build's library pages are written.
